items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You know, that great music with Blackwell and Mal Waldron. I was down there.

ctx.x: Oh boy, such great music, yeah.

You know, that great music with Blackwell and Mal Waldron. I was down there. Cause I was playing with Chico, and we weren’t workin’ a lot. I’d have to go out of town with organ trios and different kinds of stuff.
